name: listOverdueDeliverables
shortDescription: Identifies and lists all deliverables that are past their due date and have not yet been marked as approved.
description:
Overview

Queries for all Deliverable records that have a dueDate in the past and a status that is not 'approved'.

Intended use

Primarily called by a scheduler (e.g., daily cron job) to identify overdue deliverables for reporting or notifications. Can also be called by an AI agent. No parameters needed.

Logic

  1. Get the current date.
  2. Query Deliverable entities using ctx.data.query with filters: dueDate less than current date, and status not equal to 'approved'.
  3. Return the list of overdue Deliverable records.

Entities

  • Deliverable
